question: Should OpenClaw maintain BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval in the official `memory-lancedb` plugin, or route advanced LanceDB ranking to an external ClawHub plugin?
rationale: The missing capability is real, but the fix adds plugin config/defaults, FTS index lifecycle, retrieval semantics, and fallback policy that repository policy treats as product and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Keep as official plugin enhancement
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a narrow `memory-lancedb` implementation plan with dependency proof, upgrade behavior, docs, and focused tests.

options.title: Route advanced ranking to ClawHub
options.body: Close this core-repo issue and direct hybrid/reranker-heavy LanceDB variants to an externally maintained ClawHub plugin such as the already linked `memory-lancedb-pro` idea.

options.title: Defer pending memory direction
options.body: Leave the issue parked until maintainers decide whether `memory-lancedb` remains an official memory option or should stay vector-only while the default memory path converges.

recommendation.title: Keep as official plugin enhancement
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a narrow `memory-lancedb` implementation plan with dependency proof, upgrade behavior, docs, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the current source snapshot and the prior maintainer-side review comment on this issue.
